One route per page, one owner per dataset (2026-10-24)

  • Owner request: organise the app's links, pages and components. Structure, not behaviour — no new endpoint, config key or dependency.
  • One route per page. Repositories.razor answered /, /repositories and /repositories?view=overview — three addresses, two of them the same screen. Now /repositories is the list and / redirects to it. The ?view= mode is gone, and with it the page's "Overview" toggle button.
  • One owner per dataset. PortfolioOverview.razor was a 100% duplicate of the All Time Insights page — same endpoint, same KPI row, same growth chart, same heatmap, same language-mix card — so it is deleted. PortfolioHealth.razor was the Code Health data in a narrower widget; /code-health keeps it. The sidebar's "Portfolio Overview" entry went with them.
  • Routes live in one place. AppRoutes.cs holds every route and the repository detail page's tab names; AppNav.Groups is built from those constants. The routes used to be literals in eleven files — PortfolioHealth had to spell ?tab=health by hand and keep it in step with the tab array in RepositoryDetail.
  • Names match what they are. ExtensionsCounted.razor is Settings.razor now, /diag is /diagnostics, and the operator page lives under Pages/Operator/. Chart components live in Components/Charts/; the auth and account components in Components/Auth/ and Components/Account/.
  • One empty state. OnboardingEmptyState became EmptyStateKind.Onboarding — the first-run panel is the one kind of EmptyState with a second presentation, not a second component with the same job.
